title: Reconcile the queue-aware merge tool
goal: tools/merge-when-green.mjs waits for a queued PR to merge or leave the queue
acceptance: The template releases a merge-when-green that handles a merge queue (template record and tag)
NERV copies it byte for byte at that tag
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: ci.yml is a harness file: decide project-only or template first (AGENTS.md, "Changing a harness file")
Branch protection is changed by the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 after the owner chose the merge queue. Not a measurement.
